title: EU prosecutors raid far-right Patriots for Europe offices in Brussels and Strasbourg over alleged misuse of parliament funds
lede: The European Public Prosecutor’s Office (EPPO) raided the offices of Patriots for Europe in Strasbourg and Brussels.
